Yes, this is the strong search behavior I wanted. Ordinary terms matching all words, the stated operator order, and parentheses work naturally for searches like `rome (#article OR #book)`.

`#tag` should match the whole tag exactly; partial matching there could produce surprising results. I can still search ordinary text when I’m unsure of a tag’s exact name.

The syntax hint is a good start, but a small persistent “Search tips” link would be helpful because the placeholder disappears while typing and the more advanced options are easy to forget. That is a guidance improvement, not a blocker. I approve the search behavior.
